description: Browse, filter and edit Azure DevOps work items from the VS Code sidebar.
container.title: Azure Boards
config.organizations: Extra Azure DevOps organizations (the part after `dev.azure.com/`). Organizations of the signed-in account are discovered automatically; add here the ones in other tenants.
config.query: WIQL query for the "Assigned to me" view
view.welcome.noTeam:
Pick a project and team to see all of the team's work items.
[Choose team](command:board_azr_devops.switchScope)
view.welcome.emptyFiltered:
No work items match the active filters.
[Clear filters](command:board_azr_devops.clearFilters)
config.refreshMinutes: Minutes between automatic refreshes (only while the window is focused).
config.notifyAssigned: Show a notification when a work item is assigned to you.
cmd.openActive: Show work item of the current branch
config.branchTemplate: Branch name for "Start working". Placeholders: `{type}` (`bugfix` for bugs, `feature` otherwise), `{id}`, `{title}` (slug).
config.baseBranch: Branch to start from, e.g. `origin/develop`. Empty: the remote's default branch (`origin/HEAD`, then `origin/main`, `origin/master`).
config.commitReference: Prefill an empty commit message with `#<id>` of the work item of the current branch (links the commit in Azure Repos).
config.registerMcp: Offer the official Azure DevOps MCP server (`@azure-devops/mcp`) for the active organization to Copilot and other MCP clients in VS Code. Turn off if you already configured it yourself.
